title: The Piano Tuner's Notebook
transcript:
When I met piano tuner Daniel Reed, the first thing he showed me was a notebook rather than a tool. Each page described a piano he had visited, including its position in the room and any recent changes to the heating. Daniel explained that a piano can sound different even when nobody has moved or damaged it. Changes in temperature and moisture affect the wooden parts and the tension of the strings.

I asked whether an electronic device could do the whole job. He said it helped him measure notes, but it could not tell him how a player wanted the instrument to feel. He always asked the owner to play a short piece before he began. A note that seemed perfectly acceptable during a simple test might behave differently in a familiar passage.

Daniel learnt the trade while working in a music shop. At first, he thought speed was the mark of a good tuner. An experienced colleague taught him to spend longer listening before making adjustments. Daniel now leaves a few minutes between the final change and his last check, allowing the instrument to settle.

His advice to families was surprisingly simple. Avoid placing a piano beside a radiator or an open kitchen door, and tell the tuner about problems before the appointment. A clear description, he said, was often more useful than a guess about which part needed replacing.

questions.prompt: Why does Daniel record changes to room heating?
options: Temperature changes can affect a piano's sound.
He needs to calculate the household fuel bill.
Piano owners are required to report them.
questions.answer: Temperature changes can affect a piano's sound.
questions.explanation: 温度和湿度会影响木质部件及琴弦张力，因此供暖变化值得记录。

questions.prompt: Why does Daniel ask the owner to play first?
options: To judge whether the owner needs lessons.
To record music for the shop's website.
To hear how the instrument behaves during real playing.
To decide how much the piano should sell for.
questions.answer: To hear how the instrument behaves during real playing.
questions.explanation: 某个音在简单测试中正常，实际演奏熟悉曲段时却可能表现不同。

questions.prompt: What lesson did Daniel learn from his colleague?
options: Replace more parts at the first visit.
Finish every appointment as quickly as possible.
questions.explanation: 有经验的同事教他先多听再调整，改变了他认为速度最重要的看法。

questions.prompt: What does Daniel advise families to do before an appointment?
options: Describe the problems they have noticed.
Move the piano beside a radiator.
Stop using the kitchen for several days.
questions.answer: Describe the problems they have noticed.
questions.explanation: 他建议提前具体说明问题，而不是自行猜测哪个部件需要更换。
